ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated macro-level ratio is approximately 0.05:0.95 (white:black).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips (barnacle colonies). The remainder of the fluke presents as a uniform low-intensity black field punctuated by hundreds of small, circular high-contrast white ring-shaped anomalies (5-10 pixel diameter) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 35 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equivalent to ~15% of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitudes of peaks and valleys vary between 5 and 20 pixels relative to a smoothed baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory sweeping superior-laterally from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense spatial distribution of white circular pixel clusters (scars) across the ventral surface; distinct 3D-projected white clusters at both distal tips representing live barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, high-contrast horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial-lower region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) on the right lobe and exhaustive circular scarring across the entirety of both lobes; presence of live sessile organisms at the outer lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle load concentrated on the extreme lateral points of both lobes.
